statement: The Federal Open Market Committee raises the federal funds target range at its meeting concluding on 2026-10-28. Reference: target range 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: The FOMC statement released 2026-10-28 sets a target range whose upper bound is above 4.00 percent. Reference: range was 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The FOMC statement released 2026-10-28 leaves the target range at 3.75 to 4.00 percent or lowers it.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The US 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED series DGS10) closes at or above 5.50 percent on at least one business day between 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 5.25 percent on the packet date.

failure_condition: Every FRED DGS10 daily value dated between 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-30 is below 5.50 percent.
